card.name: Arsenic trioxide leukemia dosing text
card.fires_on: Spaces, numbers and linking words just before or inside arsenic trioxide and tretinoin names, in acute promyelocytic leukemia (APL) label text. It fires on dose numbers, table numbers and "treated with" before the drug name.

modes.label: Before dose numbers
modes.description: The space or number slot after Administer or in dose tables for arsenic trioxide with tretinoin.

modes.label: Before the drug name
modes.description: A linking word or word start right before arsenic or tretinoin.
modes.example: promyelocytic leukemia (APL) treated<< with>> arsenic trioxide have experienced symptoms of

modes.label: Table references
modes.description: The space before a table number in dose-modification text.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward cancer words such as cancer and carcinoma, fitting a leukemia drug context.
card.plain: It marks spots in leukemia drug labels where an arsenic trioxide and tretinoin dosing detail is about to appear.
